body:
Triage: routed **`domain:identity`** (lineage: #8243's identity-lane ruling), type **Task**, graded **`needs-user-decision`** — deliberately, because this card needs no engineering and no dev can execute it: every agent session shares the same three-repo access scope (verified in the card body: `issue_write` denied, `add_repo` cross-tier denied, direct API 403), so the only actor who can complete it is a human with upstream access. The decision-box label is used here as the maintainer's inbox for a required human ACTION, not a design fork.

**Four-prism block** (compact — this is an action request, not a design decision):
1. **Platform long-term coherence** — neutral; no code changes hinge on it.
2. **Measured business pull** — direct: the 2026-08-13 maintainer ruling on #8243 names the upstream filing as part of the deliverable and requires the link recorded on that card.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance** — n/a (no code).
4. **Startup scope discipline** — zero engineering; one human action, then close.

**Recommendation:** file the pre-drafted text (linked in the card, dedup already done against `better-auth#10734` / `#9401`) verbatim to `better-auth/better-auth`, record the returned link on #8243, close this card. Nothing is blocked on it — PR #8432 proceeds independently, as the card argues.

**Maintainer response recorded — the maintainer will file the upstream issue personally.** Provenance: maintainer live session, 2026-08-13 ~23:50Z, verbatim 「接受你的全部建议」, accepting this seat's briefing of the full decision box; this card's briefed item was: no agent path exists (three access routes measured denied), the pre-drafted text is ready verbatim, and the filing needs the maintainer's own hands (~5 minutes).

**Checklist for the filing (from the card, unchanged):**
1. Submit the pre-drafted body **verbatim** to `better-auth/better-auth`: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8243#issuecomment-5280970591
2. Record the returned upstream link on **#8243** (per that ruling's own requirement).
3. Close this card.

The card stays in the decision box until the link lands — it is the only channel that keeps this visible; no further escalation will be added (no-nag rule).

Recorded by the triage seat on the maintainer's direct channel.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Done — filed upstream: https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/issues/10819**

The maintainer filed it personally (2026-08-15), as this card and the triage seat both concluded was the only available path. All three checklist items are complete:

1. ✅ Pre-drafted body submitted **verbatim** to `better-auth/better-auth` — title and body byte-identical to the draft in https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8243#issuecomment-5280970591, nothing re-authored.
2. ✅ Link recorded on **#8243** (per that ruling's own requirement) — https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8243#issuecomment-5299968445. #8243 is closed, so it is recorded here as well, as this card provided for.
3. ✅ This card closed.

Access note, for whoever hits this next: the block was the **agent-proxy repo scope**, not GitHub permissions. A local `gh` session authenticated as `os-zhuang` reaches `better-auth/better-auth` normally. The three denials recorded in the card body were all the same scope limit measured through three different doors.

Dedup was re-run against upstream immediately before filing and still holds — no existing report covers the bearer before-hook overwriting the session cookie.
